title: New Jersey store donates $30,000 bonus after selling $847m Powerball jackpot ticket
summary_full: On November 4, a stunning Powerball ticket purchased at Wegmans Food Market in New Jersey clinched an impressive $847 million jackpot, breaking a 35-draw drought for big winners. The lucky supermarket will earn a bonus of $30,000, which is earmarked for donation to the Community FoodBank of New Jersey. New Jersey law allows lottery winners to stay anonymous indefinitely, so don't forget to check those numbers and secure your ticket!
